title: The Fat Mat
lines: Sam sat at a fat mat.
A map is at the mat.
Pam sat at the fat mat.
Tam sat at the fat mat.
Pam sat at Sam. Sam is a mat!
Sam, Pam, Tam: a fat, fat mat!

questions.ask: Who sat down on the mat first?
questions.listenFor: Sam. It is the very first line. If your child guesses, have them go back and read line one again instead of you saying it.

questions.ask: Who ended up sitting on Sam?
questions.listenFor: Pam. You are listening for the name, not the whole sentence. If they are unsure, have them find the line that says it.

questions.ask: What do you think happens to the mat next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer here. Listen for a reason pulled from the story, like three kids piled up or the mat getting fatter. A reason matters more than the guess.
